what: A coordinated freight order for 80 loaves of bread, with deliveries/collections and baking underway; Builder supplied the baker lanterns and planks, and at the hall visit the builder, freight worker, and innkeeper were gathered amid extensive new lanterns and chests. Evidence does not support the rumored bridge or port change. Neighbour knowingly relayed details, but the exact participants in the loaf order are not fully established firsthand by the mayor; freight and innkeeper are present at the lighting inspection, not proven helpers to the order.
